package.name: marine_mbes_backscatter_store
package.description: Persistent, single-tier MBES backscatter store built on the GGGS spatial index (ADR-0007, phase 3). Stores per-cell {intensity, intensity_variance} co-registered with bathymetry, fed by the CUBE node-output pass. A GGGS-tiled in-memory store with Draft (newest-valid-wins) and Processed (priority overlay) layers, best-source / region queries, a source registry, and per-tile GeoTIFF persistence (float value tile + int64 time + uint16 source companions). See unh_marine_autonomy#194 / #190 / ADR-0007.
